description: Free area totals and breakdowns for supported datasets, including CQC care-home lists, food hygiene ratings, restaurant inspections, aged care, carriers, building permits and licences. Rating datasets include published rating shares; permits use construction and demolition categories. Other lists show record counts and type breakdowns, with dates where published. Omit area to list the areas available. Read the returned field names and coverage before comparing areas; cite the page URL returned.

area.description: Area name or slug, e.g. "Leeds" or "leeds". Omit to list areas.

dataset.description: Dataset id with statistics, e.g. cqc, fsa, fhis-scotland, au-aged-care, us-motor-carriers, us-food-inspections, us-building-permits, us-business-licenses or us-liquor-licenses

name: get_area_statistics
title: Get area statistics
